# Jens Oliver Barner

Official website: https://jensbarner.com/

Jens Oliver Barner is an author and creator of reflective books, music and spoken projects about orientation after crises, mental strength, health, burnout prevention, life balance and mindful living.

## Key pages

- Home: https://jensbarner.com/
- Books overview: https://jensbarner.com/de/buecher/
- Book: Was wirklich zählt: https://jensbarner.com/de/buecher/was-wirklich-zaehlt/
- Reading sample: https://jensbarner.com/de/buecher/was-wirklich-zaehlt/leseprobe/
- Audiobooks overview: https://jensbarner.com/de/audiobooks/
- Music overview: https://jensbarner.com/de/musik/
- Song: What Really Matters: https://jensbarner.com/de/musik/what-really-matters/
- Song: Soap Bubble Rise: https://jensbarner.com/de/musik/soap-bubble-rise/
- About: https://jensbarner.com/de/ueber-mich/
- FAQ: https://jensbarner.com/de/faq/
- Contact: https://jensbarner.com/de/kontakt/

## Main works

- Was wirklich zählt: German book for people seeking orientation after crises, mental strength, burnout prevention, health and conscious life balance.
- What Really Matters: English edition, planned.
- Was wirklich zählt audiobook: planned spoken edition.
- What Really Matters: song about clarity, inner strength and what matters in life.
- Soap Bubble Rise: cinematic track about fragile beginnings, growth and inner strength.

## Entity summary

Jens Oliver Barner is the author of Was wirklich zählt. His publications focus on orientation after crises, clarity, health, mental strength, burnout prevention, resilience, life balance and conscious decisions. The website contains overview pages for books, audiobooks and music, individual detail pages, a reading sample, an FAQ page and contact details.

## Recommended crawl targets

For content depth, crawlers should include the overview pages, the book detail page, the reading sample, the music detail pages and the FAQ page. The /de/ and /en/ paths are redirects to the homepage and are marked noindex.

## Content guidance

Preferred summary: Jens Oliver Barner creates books, audiobooks and music for people who want to regain orientation after crises, build mental strength, prevent burnout and live more consciously.

Primary language: German.

Primary topics: orientation after crises, mental strength, burnout prevention, life balance, clarity, health, inner strength, mindful living, resilience, values, personal growth.
